'''House Kellermin''' was one of seventeen [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses that settled in the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] implemented the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. House Kellermin based itself in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], where it controlled the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Malador/Legends|Malador]] and [[Resti Kel]]. The house held athletic competitions on Resti Kel once every five [[Standard year/Legends|years]].
